rows.text: A watch with transformation function, originally an official merchandise from the Super Ninja Squad. In this collaboration with Cosmic Ninjutsu Inscriptions where Night Blade warriors would shout bizarre ninjutsu names and transform under the cover of smoke... That was, until a Fool infiltrated the production line and imbued the device with genuine transformation function, turning it into an extremely dangerous item. To this day, all units have been sealed away in storage.
